topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins compromises QoS guarantees, increasing latency and jitter. Adaptive modulation and coding, beamforming techniques, and traffic engineering can mitigate this trade-off by optimizing resource utilization and minimizing interference, preserving link budget performance for safety-critical traffic.
reference_context: QoS provisioning and link characteristic identification are crucial in SatCom and RF Engineering to balance revenue-driven services with safety margin requirements.
